mapper.insert:
insert into `meattrade_statistics`(id,supplier_id,pork_report_code,average_price,highest_price,lower_price,pork_arrange_slices,deal_slices, pork_arrange_weight,deal_weight,amount,commission,statistics_date,tenant,deleted,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values
(#{item.id},#{item.supplierId},#{item.porkReportCode},#{item.averagePrice},#{item.highestPrice},#{item.lowerPrice},#{item.porkArrangeSlices},#{item.dealSlices}, #{item.porkArrangeWeight},#{item.dealWeight},#{item.amount},#{item.commission},#{item.statisticsDate}, #{item.tenant},#{item.deleted},#{item.createBy},#{item.createTime},#{item.updateBy},#{item.updateTime})
on duplicate key update average_price = (average_price + values(average_price)) / 2, lower_price = case when values(lower_price) > lower_price then lower_price else values(lower_price) end, highest_price = case when values(highest_price) > highest_price then values(highest_price) else highest_price end, deal_slices = deal_slices + values(deal_slices), deal_weight = deal_weight + values(deal_weight), amount = amount + values(amount), commission = commission + values(commission)
mapper.select: select AVG(average_price) AS average_price, MIN(lower_price) AS lower_price, MAX(highest_price) AS highest_price, SUM(pork_arrange_slices) AS pork_arrange_slices, SUM(deal_slices) AS deal_slices, SUM(pork_arrange_weight) AS pork_arrange_weight, SUM(deal_weight) AS deal_weight, SUM(amount) AS amount, SUM(commission) AS commission from `meattrade_statistics`
